engineeringSkip.reason: A speculative 'hive mind' built on quantum-entangled brain links has no basis in known physics or neuroscience — entanglement cannot carry signals between brains, and no research programme exists behind it.

factCheck.reason: Quantum entanglement cannot transmit information between brains — the no-communication theorem rules it out — so the claimed neural 'mesh' has no basis in known physics or neuroscience.
